feature_spotlight.headline: Everything You Need, All in One Place
feature_spotlight.description: Seamlessly manage your tasks, schedules, and notes with features designed to keep you organized and efficient.
feature_spotlight.card_organization_body: Say goodbye to the chaos of multiple apps. Streamline your life in a single platform.
feature_spotlight.card_reflection_body: Foster a habit of reflection and gratitude. Capture the beauty in everyday moments.
feature_spotlight.card_focus_body: Keep priorities and notes in view so deep work gets fewer interruptions and attention stays where it matters.
feature_spotlight.card_productivity_body: Leverage our task management system to break down your goals into actionable steps.
feature_spotlight.card_social_body: Easily coordinate with friends, family, and colleagues. Share journal entries with just a click.
feature_spotlight.card_privacy_body: Your information is yours alone. We prioritize your privacy with state-of-the-art encryption.

workflow.headline: Four steps. One calmer week.
workflow.description: Stay organized with a simple rhythm — capture what matters, turn it into clear plans, protect your focus, and reflect with confidence.

workflow.commit_body: Protect deep work and must-dos while leaving room for real life to happen.
workflow.reflect_body: End the week with memory, not guesswork — start Monday with clarity and context.
